product_metadata.title: Amazer Chrome Shower Curtain Rod Extra Long 78-110 inches Adjustable Shower Rod Tension Spring Curtain Rod No Drill for Bathroom Bedroom Study Window Closet Doorway, Chrome
features: Easy installation - tension mounting. No cutting, drilling or tools needed to install Amazer shower curtain rods. Follow the instruction on our listing photo, in the video or on the manual. The end of the shower curtain rod is detachable, you can match the hooks and shower curtains you want.

Stable & non-slip - powerful spring. Under the premise of correct installation, the maximum load-bearing capacity of Amazer tension shower rod for size 42-72 inches is 30 pounds. The longer the rod, the weaker the load-bearing. Please do not overload the shower curtain rod and prevent it from falling off due to uneven force.

Adjustable length & optional colors. Please read our product listing carefully before purchase. Measure your wall distance, then you can find the recommended rod. The size for this shower curtain rod is 78-110 inches, and the corresponding recommended wall distance is 91-110 inches. Refer to the full page for more details.

Suitable for most surfaces. Our Amazer tension shower curtain rods apply to most surfaces including both smooth and rough surfaces like wallpaper wall, tile wall, wooden frame, etc. Attention: our shower curtain rods are not recommended to use on painted walls and uneven surfaces.
Not just for bathroom - The spring curtain rod can also be used for windows, closets, doors in the bedroom, kitchen, study or on the balcony.
